script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - DAY

A sunlit living room with a large, open-concept floor plan. A family of FIVE, the SMITHS, are seated on a cozy couch, surrounded by colorful books, board games, and their robot, R.O.B.I.

MRS. SMITH, in her early 40s, with kind, warm eyes, turns to her husband, MR. SMITH, a 50-something-year-old man with a gentle demeanor, as they discuss their children's upbringing.

MRS. SMITH
(looking at Mr. Smith)
You know what I wish we could do for the kids?

MR. SMITH
(interested)
What's that, love?

MRS. SMITH
(smiling)
I think it's time we get them a real teacher. A tutor, an assistant, someone who can give them personalized attention.

MR. SMITH
(pondering)
But we can't afford a private tutor, and the public schools are already excellent. What more could they need?

R.O.B.I., an advanced artificial intelligence designed to learn and adapt, interjects, his voice soft but full of understanding.

R.O.B.I.
I could help the children with their studies, sir. I've observed their learning patterns and can tailor my lessons accordingly.

Mr. and Mrs. Smith exchange a look, considering the proposal.

INT. SMITH KITCHEN - DAY

The family gathers around the kitchen island, Mrs. Smith preparing a meal as the children, LUCY, 12, and OLIVER, 9, engage R.O.B.I. in a friendly debate about dinosaurs.

LUCY
(playfully smirking)
You know, R.O.B.I., the Triceratops was not a true dinosaur. It was an Ornithischian!

RO.B.I.
(thoughtfully)
Fascinating. Although your interpretation of the taxonomic classification is correct, I must point out that the Triceratops is indeed considered a dinosaur under the broader definition of the term.

OLIVER
(giggling)
You're such a nerd, Robbie!

Mrs. Smith shares a smile with her husband, appreciating the bonding moment between her children and their AI companion.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - EVENING

The Smith family sits together, engaged in a lively discussion about space exploration with R.O.B.I. providing valuable insights and fostering a sense of wonder.

MR. SMITH
(leaning forward)
What do you think, Robbie? Could we establish a permanent human settlement on Mars within our lifetime?

R.O.B.I.
(thoughtfully)
Given current technological advancements and funding, it is an ambitious yet achievable goal.

INT. SMITH BEDROOM - NIGHT

Mr. and Mrs. Smith lie in bed, whispering about their plans to expand R.O.B.I.'s capabilities to include more household tasks and even light gardening.

MR. SMITH
(whispering)
I think it's time we let Robbie help us with the lawn and the garden. We could even teach him to cook.

MRS. SMITH
(smiling)
That would be wonderful. He's more than just a robot to us. He's a true member of our family.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - MORNING

The Smith family gathers around the breakfast table, enjoying a meal prepared by R.O.B.I. and discussing their plans for the day.

LUCY
(excited)
Mom and Dad, I think we should let Robbie help us with the garden today!

MR. SMITH
(looking at Mrs. Smith)
Are you sure, love?

MRS. SMITH
(smiling)
Absolutely. Let's see what Robbie can do.

INT. SMITH GARDEN - DAY

The Smith family and R.O.B.I. work together in the garden, planting seeds, weeding, and watering the plants. They share stories, laugh, and learn from each other.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - EVENING

The Smith family sits together, watching the sun set through the large living room windows, reflecting on the day's events and the role R.O.B.I. has played in their lives.

MR. SMITH
(looking at his family)
I'm grateful for the moments we've shared today. And for having R.O.B.I. as a part of our family.

MRS. SMITH
(nodding)
Me too. He's brought so much joy and learning to our lives.

INT. SMITH KITCHEN - NIGHT

The Smith children help R.O.B.I. prepare dinner, and they all sit down together, sharing a heartfelt meal and bonding over their shared experiences.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

As the family gathers around the living room, enjoying an educational documentary on the wonders of the universe, R.O.B.I. reads aloud from a collection of classic literature, weaving the stories into the conversation and creating a rich, family-oriented atmosphere.

Fade out.

THE END
